provenance.capture: Local PI_CURSOR_SDK_EVENT_DEBUG onDelta turn-ended samples (fable@300k; same flat-input/cache-shift shape on composer-2.5)
notes: Official TypeScript SDK docs and installed usage-types toTokenUsage treat TokenUsage.totalTokens as inputTokens+outputTokens+cacheReadTokens+cacheWriteTokens (additive fields).
Observed raw local turn-ended.usage keeps inputTokens as the full prompt (nearly flat across turns) while cacheReadTokens/cacheWriteTokens partition that prompt.
pi-cursor-sdk maps raw turn-ended.usage, not SDK toTokenUsage: input = inputTokens-cacheRead-cacheWrite; occupancy totalTokens is estimated from replayable local context.

Mapping update: SDK cacheReadTokens/cacheWriteTokens are billing sums across invocations (never context occupancy). pi-ai's silent-overflow check reads usage.input + usage.cacheRead as prompt size, so pi-cursor-sdk zeroes the overflow-visible pi cache fields and carries the real SDK billing on the host-ignored usage.cursorSdk carrier.
The raw capture remains pinned to 1.0.23; the contract test explicitly verifies the published transform and schema against the installed 1.0.27 package.

runtimeDivergenceEvidence.interpretation: If raw fields were additive/disjoint, turn-002 inputTokens would drop toward the uncached remainder (~4.9k). Observed inputTokens stayed nearly flat while cacheRead absorbed prior cacheWrite, proving partition/full-prompt semantics for raw turn-ended.usage.
